items.title: How we work: a short guide for new starters
items.text:
# How we work

We move goods between ports for our customers, safely and on time.

## Your first week

- Meet your team lead and read your floor's library.
- Book the safety briefing with Operations.
- Ask Legal and Compliance before you sign anything on the company's behalf.

items.title: Quarterly update: summer
items.text:
# Quarterly update: summer

Volumes rose through the season. Two new berths opened, and the fleet's on-time rate held above target.

## Next quarter

- Finish the crane replacement at the north terminal.
- Review the fuel contracts before renewal.

items.title: Berth allocation procedure
items.text:
# Berth allocation

1. Confirm the vessel's arrival window with the agent.
2. Check draught against the berth's limit.
3. Book pilots and tugs.
4. Record the allocation and tell the terminal.

items.text:
# Sanctions screening

Screen every new customer, vessel and counterparty before the first booking, and again on any change of owner or flag.
